text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A construction company director was fined for not ensuring that workers on a construction site used safety equipment. Their failure caused the death of a worker.

- Hyundai General, the largest container vessel ever to enter Malta Freeport, came to Malta on Monday following a contract between the freeport and Hyundai Merchant Marine of South Korea which will use Malta as a Mediterranean trans-shipment hub.

- Opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami expresses concern over proposed new taxation system. The government is to replace VAT by a new system based mostly on customs and excise duty. The Opposition Nationalist Party has claimed it will increase production costs and the cost of living.
- Medicine suppliers had been owed 3.5 million million pounds ($10 million) by the former government. The Labour government has attacked the former government for not paying suppliers promptly.
